messages.subject: For Sweco Group leadership | Infrastructure, sustainability and government stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Sweco Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Sweco Group leadership and the Board as the company enters its next leadership phase.

Sweco's work across energy, water, infrastructure, urban development and societal resilience requires disciplined alignment across governments, communities, clients and sustainability priorities. That interface closely matches my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex stakeholder execution across regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and infrastructure stakeholder strategy might support Sweco's next phase of growth. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Sweco.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
